_about: Manufacturer-specific trouble codes (P1xxx, P3xxx, U1xxx...). Makers reuse these numbers with different meanings across models and years, so each title is the most widely documented meaning, not a guarantee. Confirm with a factory service manual or a dealer-level scanner (FORScan, Techstream, GDS...) before buying parts.

Ford.about: Ford, Lincoln and Mercury. Ford engines: bank 1 is the side with cylinder 1 (passenger side on Ford V8s and V6s), sensor 1 is before the catalytic converter, sensor 2 after it.

codes.P1000: OBD-II monitor testing not complete (normal after a battery disconnect or code clear; drive to finish)
codes.P1001: KOER (key on, engine running) self-test not able to complete
codes.P1101: Mass air flow (MAF) sensor out of self-test range
codes.P1116: Engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor out of self-test range
codes.P1120: Throttle position sensor out of range (low)
codes.P1121: Throttle position sensor inconsistent with MAF sensor
codes.P1124: Throttle position sensor out of self-test range
codes.P1130: Lack of upstream O2 sensor switch, adaptive fuel at limit (bank 1)
codes.P1131: Lack of upstream O2 sensor switch, sensor indicates lean (bank 1)
codes.P1132: Lack of upstream O2 sensor switch, sensor indicates rich (bank 1)
codes.P1150: Lack of upstream O2 sensor switch, adaptive fuel at limit (bank 2)
codes.P1151: Lack of upstream O2 sensor switch, sensor indicates lean (bank 2)
codes.P1152: Lack of upstream O2 sensor switch, sensor indicates rich (bank 2)
codes.P1270: Engine RPM or vehicle speed limiter reached
codes.P1288: Cylinder head temperature (CHT) sensor out of self-test range
codes.P1289: Cylinder head temperature (CHT) sensor circuit high input
codes.P1290: Cylinder head temperature (CHT) sensor circuit low input
codes.P1299: Cylinder head over temperature protection active (engine running in fail-safe)
codes.P1351: Ignition diagnostic monitor (IDM) circuit input fault
codes.P1400: DPFE (EGR pressure feedback) sensor circuit low
codes.P1401: DPFE (EGR pressure feedback) sensor circuit high
codes.P1405: DPFE sensor upstream hose off or plugged
codes.P1406: DPFE sensor downstream hose off or plugged
codes.P1443: EVAP purge flow sensor / purge system fault
codes.P1450: Unable to bleed up fuel tank vacuum (EVAP)
codes.P1505: Idle air control system at adaptive limit
codes.P1516: Intake manifold runner control input error (bank 1)
codes.P1517: Intake manifold runner control input error (bank 2)
codes.P1518: Intake manifold runner control stuck open
codes.P1633: Keep alive power (KAM) voltage too low
codes.P1635: Tire / axle ratio out of acceptable range (PCM programmed for a different tire size or axle)
codes.P1639: Vehicle ID block corrupted or not programmed
codes.P1703: Brake on/off switch out of self-test range
codes.P1705: Transmission range sensor out of self-test range
codes.P1711: Transmission fluid temperature sensor out of self-test range
codes.P1780: Transmission control switch (O/D cancel) circuit out of self-test range
codes.P1781: 4x4 low switch out of self-test range
codes.U1900: CAN communication bus fault, receive error
codes.B1342: Electronic control unit is defective (body module)
codes.B1676: Battery pack voltage out of range

Mazda.about: Mazda shares many systems and codes with Ford on 2000s-early 2010s models (Mazda 6, Tribute, CX-7/CX-9). Skyactiv models (2012+) use mostly generic codes.

codes.P1000: OBD-II monitor testing not complete (drive to finish after a code clear)
codes.P1449: EVAP canister drain cut valve circuit

GM.about: General Motors (Chevrolet, GMC, Buick, Cadillac). GM uses mostly generic P0/P2 codes on newer vehicles; P1 codes are more common on 1996-2007 models.

codes.P1134: O2 sensor transition time ratio (bank 1 sensor 1)
codes.P1154: O2 sensor transition time ratio (bank 2 sensor 1)
codes.P1380: Misfire detected, rough road data not available (ABS)
codes.P1381: Misfire detected, no communication with brake/ABS module
codes.P1516: Throttle actuator control module, throttle actuator position performance
codes.P1626: Theft deterrent fuel enable signal not received
codes.P1631: Theft deterrent password incorrect / start enable signal not correct
codes.P1860: Torque converter clutch PWM solenoid circuit
codes.U1000: Class 2 serial data link malfunction (older GM)

Chrysler.about: Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep and Ram (FCA/Stellantis). Most P1 codes below are from 1996-2007 models; newer ones mostly use generic codes.

codes.P1192: Inlet air temperature sensor circuit low
codes.P1193: Inlet air temperature sensor circuit high
codes.P1281: Engine is cold too long (thermostat usually stuck open)
codes.P1389: No ASD relay output voltage at PCM
codes.P1391: Intermittent loss of camshaft or crankshaft position sensor
codes.P1398: Misfire adaptive numerator at limit (crankshaft sensor target learning)
codes.P1486: EVAP leak monitor pinched hose found
codes.P1494: Leak detection pump switch or mechanical fault
codes.P1496: 5 volt sensor supply output too low
codes.P1521: Incorrect engine oil type (HEMI with cylinder deactivation)
codes.P1684: Battery disconnected within the last 50 starts (memory only, no fault)
codes.P1687: No communication with the instrument cluster
codes.P1693: Fault detected in companion module (check the other computer for codes)
codes.P1740: Torque converter clutch or overdrive solenoid performance
codes.P1762: Governor pressure sensor offset volts too low or high
codes.P1763: Governor pressure sensor volts too high
codes.P1764: Governor pressure sensor volts too low
codes.P1765: Transmission 12 volt supply relay control circuit

Toyota.about: Toyota, Lexus and Scion. Toyota's A/F (air-fuel ratio) sensors are the upstream oxygen sensors on most 2000+ models.

codes.P1127: Electronic throttle actuator power source circuit

codes.P1009: Variable valve timing control (VTC) advance malfunction
codes.P1077: Intake manifold runner control (IMRC) low RPM
codes.P1078: Intake manifold runner control (IMRC) high RPM
codes.P1297: Electrical load detector (ELD) circuit low input
codes.P1298: Electrical load detector (ELD) circuit high input
codes.P1456: EVAP leak detected, fuel tank side (often the gas cap)
codes.P1457: EVAP leak detected, canister side (often the canister vent shut valve)

Hyundai-Kia.about: Hyundai, Kia and Genesis. Many share engines (Theta, Nu, Gamma, Lambda) and codes.

codes.P1326: Knock Sensor Detection System (KSDS): engine bearing wear detected. Covered by a Hyundai/Kia recall and extended warranty on many Theta II engines: contact a dealer before driving far.

Nissan.about: Nissan and Infiniti. NATS is Nissan's immobilizer.

codes.P1446: EVAP canister vent control valve closed
codes.P1448: EVAP canister vent control valve open
codes.P1611: NATS immobilizer: ID discord between ECM and immobilizer
codes.U1000: CAN communication line (modules not hearing each other)

Subaru.about: Subaru. Boxer engines: bank 1 is the side with cylinders 1 and 3 (passenger side), bank 2 has cylinders 2 and 4.

codes.P1400: Fuel tank pressure control solenoid valve circuit low
codes.P1443: Vent control solenoid valve function problem

VW.about: Volkswagen and Audi. VW modules also store their own 5-digit VAG fault codes that a generic OBD2 reader can't see; VCDS or OBDeleven reads those.

codes.P1136: Long term fuel trim, additive air, bank 1 system too lean
codes.P1137: Long term fuel trim, additive air, bank 1 system too rich
codes.P1176: O2 correction behind catalyst, bank 1, limit attained
codes.P1297: Pressure hose between turbocharger and throttle valve (boost leak)

BMW.about: BMW and Mini. BMW modules store their own hex fault codes (e.g. 2A87) that a generic OBD2 reader can't see; ISTA, INPA or a BMW-capable scanner reads those. The OBD2 P-codes here are mostly generic.
